images.name: hero-objects
images.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: conceptual product image for a design-led 3D printed home decor website, editorial hero, landscape 1536x1024.
Primary request: An exceptional restrained editorial still life of matte FDM 3D printed objects: one large petrol green sculptural ribbed vase with an open mouth, one cream arched small sculptural vase, and one low terracotta wavy catchall tray.
Scene/backdrop: warm ivory plinths against a warm neutral seamless studio background.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, products occupy center and right, generous quiet negative space on left, all objects fully visible in a carefully balanced arrangement.
Lighting/mood: natural directional side light, soft shadows, calm sophisticated editorial mood.
Materials/textures: tactile matte 3D printed plastic, fine visible horizontal FDM layer lines, refined surface and ribbing.
Constraints: three designed objects only; no text, no humans, no logos, no watermark.

images.name: pet
images.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: square conceptual product render for a design-led 3D printed decor website, 1024x1024.
Primary request: an adorable stylized sitting calico cat miniature, full body, with rounded ears, soft simplified sculptural shapes, feet and tail close to the body.
Scene/backdrop: low pale sandstone plinth, light warm neutral seamless studio background.
Composition/framing: centered full miniature, tasteful close editorial product composition with breathing room.
Lighting/mood: studio side light, soft warm shadows, charming and refined.
Color palette: four clearly delineated colors on the miniature: ivory, black, terracotta, and muted pink. Solid material color areas, no fuzzy fur.
Materials/textures: tactile matte fine FDM 3D printing layer lines, collectible sculptural miniature.
Constraints: clearly a designed plastic miniature, not a real animal; no text, no logos, no watermark, no UI.
